name: helpdeskpro
description: HelpDeskPro - Système de tickets support (PERN Stack)

scripts.setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
